reasoning: There are no general-election polls of the Tennessee 2026 U.S. Senate race or fresh Tennessee-specific presidential general-election polls in the last 45 days from major outlets; the available coverage is almost entirely about the August 2026 primaries and intraparty contests, which do not provide a D vs. R general-election margin. Recent primary coverage consistently portrays Republican incumbents and candidates as dominant in statewide contests, and no credible source in this window suggests a competitive general election, so the best characterization of the current general-election environment is that Republicans are clearly favored but without a quantified recent margin. Structurally, Tennessee’s Cook Partisan Voting Index of R+14 underscores a strong Republican lean, which is consistent with the absence of any evidence that Democrats have made the race competitive in recent weeks.
